projects.name: Lending Workflow Transformation Platform
details: Domain: Financial Services | Retail Banking | Lending Operations | Workflow Automation
• Collaborated with business stakeholders from global financial institutions including Northern Trust, BNY Mellon,
Citi, SEI, Jackson National, Columbia Threadneedle, Virtus, Alps, Thrivent, Ultimus, Silver Lake, PostFinance, and
SWIFT to gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Delivered business analysis for Investment Operations, workflow automation, and retail lending transformation
initiatives across enterprise banking platforms.
• Supported Asset Servicing, Custody Operations, Securities Processing, Trade Processing, Trade Settlement, Cash
Operations, Corporate Actions, Reconciliation, and Client Onboarding workflows by translating operational
requirements into Epics, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and business rules.
• Performed AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, Business Capability Mapping, Value Stream Mapping, Process Architecture,
and Process Design to improve operational efficiency and support enterprise transformation.
• Contributed to Target Operating Model (TOM) and Operating Model Transformation initiatives by documenting
future-state operating processes, workflow routing, governance, approval hierarchies, and service-level
requirements.
• Managed and prioritised a backlog of 200+ user stories while collaborating with Product Owners, Architects,
Engineering, QA, and Operations teams within a SAFe Agile environment.
• Defined business rules for trade lifecycle, settlement workflows, exception handling, reconciliation, client
onboarding, and workflow automation to improve operational efficiency and regulatory compliance.
• Supported UAT, defect triage, release planning, and business sign-off while ensuring successful delivery of workflow
automation capabilities.
• Leveraged JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft Copilot, and ChatGPT for requirements management, documentation,
backlog prioritisation, and productivity improvements.
